role: Software Dev Engineer I - Security Platform
paragraphs: I both stream and watch on Twitch, so I've seen from the user side what it takes to keep live communities safe. That's why the Security Platform SDE I role in Irvine stands out to me. The team builds the services, pipelines and automation behind Twitch's security, privacy and compliance programs, and that is where I want to start my career. I'm local to Irvine/Orange County and finished my B.S. in Computer Science at UC Irvine, specializing in Networked Systems.

The closest thing I've done to this work is CommunicAI, an iOS app I built and still operate, live on the App Store. I own its backend security end to end. I implemented the cloud authentication flows (Sign in with Apple with nonce and SHA-256 hashing, Google OAuth, and verified email/password) and put Firebase App Check in front of every backend request. I wrote server-authoritative Node.js Cloud Functions that enforce authentication, input validation, and per-user and global rate limiting. I also built privacy features, including full account and data deletion and automated, scheduled data-retention cleanup. My role-based authorization rules block IDOR, privilege escalation and message spoofing, and 36 adversarial unit tests check them.

I learn fast because I've had to. As captain of UC Irvine's NCAA Division I track and field team, I balance training, leading teammates and coursework in Software Engineering, Security and Privacy, Computer Networks and Operating Systems. I'm also taking the CompTIA Security+ exam in January and I have hands-on experience with AWS, including DynamoDB.
I'd welcome the chance to bring that mix of software and security to the Security Platform team. I'm available for a Summer 2027 start and happy to talk about how I can help.
